integrity: A self-contained analytic proof establishes all-dimensional assertions. Finite exact-arithmetic verification is only supplementary. Prior results including the general Godbersen inequality and planar Rogers--Shephard inequality are credited and not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: The sharp envelope and stability are restricted to Cartesian products of full-dimensional planar convex factors. The stability deficit is a scalar planar Rogers--Shephard deficit, not a metric distance. The central asymptotic holds as the number of factors tends to infinity. Earlier unindexed equivalent tensorization results remain a historical-priority risk.
title: Sharp Godbersen coefficient envelopes and stability for products of planar convex bodies
